full_judgment: 10. We find from the impugned judgment that the High Court Division observed that the plaintiffs did not claim to have been out of possession either in the plaint or in the deposition, but they claimed part possession in the suit property and hence, it was observed that the trial Court took an erroneous view in this respect by finding that the suit of the plaintiffs is one for recovery of khas possession, and that the appellate Court came to a categorical finding that possession of one of the co-sharer is possession of all co-sharers. The High Court Division also noted that the appellate Judge considered and accepted Exhibit-4; which is a registered kabala dated 10.06.1958 by which Moijan transferred her share of .42 acre of land to the plaintiffs.
